spiritual_reading.full_translation:
A Divine admission into living conjunction and a containing calm stands open within the heavenly domain of wisdom as an ever-present inflowing illumination into outer life. Yet the adversarial love of self, knowing that this same opening leads minds out of bondage, set within its ruling falsity a forbidding decree that no one should acknowledge that source, insinuating that anyone who turns to it will lose life. It recast that inflowing wisdom as something doomed to be extinguished, blocked minds from directing their inner regard toward illumination, and drove them to reject the truth by which their humanity stands.

People are in ignorance about spiritual realities: they do not grasp the magnitude of that illuminating Divine presence, they reject the free gift continually extended to them, and they fail to perceive its holiness. They also do not understand the goods it accomplishes for them even while they still live in external states; for whenever wisdom flows down into the outer person it performs innumerable mercies for the human race, and yet they deny benefits whose origin they will not recognize.

Whenever this illumination is received into external life, it brings a complete course of operations that can be perceived.

First, it enlightens: it opens the understanding in all people so that they can discern in conduct what lies before them, and it removes the obscurity of falsity that had made them unable to see.

Second, it brings tranquility and peace: when wisdom enters the outer person it brings calming order throughout, and it removes the anxieties and tremors that filled the inner life during obscurity; it dispels falsity by truth, and through that quieting influx fear is extinguished.

Third, it awakens into vigilance: when illumination comes, those who were in spiritual sleep rise into attention, and the outermost faculties that had been strained in anxious guarding relax from that strained watchfulness, because truth present in ultimates restores orderly use.

Fourth, it fructifies the whole lower life: it gives nourishment and vigor, discernment and delight, to perceptions and to the works that proceed from them, and it vitalizes general and particular truths and tender beginnings of good throughout the whole extent of external life.

Fifth, it restrains predatory evils: when enlightenment spreads through the outer person, malicious cravings and violent falsities withdraw into their hidden interiors.

Sixth, it heals and breaks enchantment: when truth shines, the pain of spiritual injury is eased, and the deceptive practices by which the wicked act upon others are dissolved.

Seventh, it bears witness and makes manifest: it makes evident in the natural degree a sign that the heavenly domain of wisdom is real and present; it is an outward testimony of inward Divine splendor, and through it illumination is extended through the whole created mind.

Great folly has seized those who are in falsified worship: they neither perceive the holy secret of this illuminating presence nor even attend to its obvious benefits. They let these benefits pass without recognition.

There is also the opposite state, the state of obscurity, within which evils find opportunity; whenever it descends upon external life it brings a complete course of infestations.

First, falsity spreads: when illumination is withdrawn from the outer mind, obscurity extends through the natural degree; understanding is filled with denial and confusion, and people neither discern nor rightly perceive because falsity dominates their outer life.

Second, fear strengthens: dread and trembling seize human minds, and external life is filled with the oppressive presence of that state.

Third, rebellion arises within: when truth is absent, affections and thoughts rise into disorder, and the heart turns toward doing evils and rushing into spiritual ruin.

Fourth, stupor settles: negligence and listlessness take hold, and people become deathlike in respect to what is living.

Fifth, what is human is concealed and distorted: when falsity covers outer life, the distinct form of each person’s quality is hidden; mutual recognition of what is good and true is obscured, and what should appear as spiritual beauty is not manifested.

Sixth, evildoing is empowered: when obscurity rules, profanations of good, thefts of truth for self, and secret poisons against understanding come into action; bestial affections and crawling falsities rise from hidden loves and prowl in external life; infernal influences gain freer operation; conflicts, assaults, injuries, and outpourings of harm torment people because every evil is strengthened.

Seventh, infernal origin is displayed: obscurity makes manifest in outer life the active falsity from which it proceeds, because it is an effect of primal denial made present in externals; this effect intertwines and binds disordered things in both higher and lower regions of the mind.

These recurring infestations of obscurity can be understood, yet those in error do not know what this state is nor the source of its strength—that evils are empowered within it.

Within illumination as it acts in the outer person there is a sufficient set of universal qualities.

First is enlightenment itself, by which the natural mind and all affections and thoughts in it are enabled to see.

Second is spiritual beauty, by which ordered truth gives loveliness and attractiveness to the life.

Third is peace, by which gentler affection is received and mutual concord is established.

Fourth is liberation of the living inner life, by which the mind is released from compulsions and entanglements in higher and lower bondage so that it can act in freedom according to order.

Fifth is strengthening in ultimates together with delight in the whole complex of doctrine that bears witness to Divine love and wisdom.

These qualities are pre-eminent: the enlightenment surpasses all lesser understandings in the natural degree; the beauty it imparts surpasses merely natural attractiveness; its peace exceeds all external securities; its liberation is beyond other kinds of release; and the strength it supplies to operative powers in ultimates exceeds every natural power.

Beyond these, further universal marks become apparent through this illumination, disclosing something of the First Divine.

First is unceasing plenitude: the receptive form through which this influx acts remains continually full and does not diminish by alternations as derivative illumination does; thus the Divine Source is inexhaustible, from whom all capacities and objects of worship in the mind proceed, and in whom there is no lack.

Second is incomparable supremacy: the wisdom of this influx exceeds all lesser truths and derivative lights in the whole mental universe, bearing witness that the Divine Light surpasses even the light of heavenly degrees.

Third is transcendence of degree: this illumination stands above all elevated natural states and every exalted condition attainable in external life, bearing witness that the Divine is above the whole ordered heaven of wisdom and above every height of spiritual life, and that Divine fullness remains in its own likeness from eternity to eternity.

Two mysteries are thus set before the created mind again and again: enlightenment and obscurity, and with them the difference between truth from good and falsity from evil. Yet those in error do not recognize them.

The primary mystery of Divine illumination is made present in the natural degree as a secondary inflowing light that comes continually into outer life. In all its operations it shows that it is good, proceeding from good itself; it comes from the good Divine Source and becomes apparent in external existence.

In contrast, the state of obscurity, full of fear, exists from active falsity; it displays its origin by its evils in external life. This too is manifested continually, yet those in error do not know it and do not distinguish enlightenment from obscurity.

Those who receive and live from illumination are born from it and belong to it; those who take on the quality of obscurity are born from that state and belong to it.

Blessed are those who know within themselves the mystery of these two states: that enlightenment comes from the Divine Light and obscurity from active falsity; that they do not arise from one another; and that by distinguishing their two origins—good with its truth, and evil with its falsity—the mind is led into eternal life.

paragraph_translations.translation: A Divine admission into living conjunction and a containing calm stands open within the heavenly domain of wisdom as an ever-present inflowing illumination into outer life. Yet the adversarial love of self, knowing that this same opening leads minds out of bondage, set within its ruling falsity a forbidding decree that no one should acknowledge that source, insinuating that anyone who turns to it will lose life. It recast that inflowing wisdom as something doomed to be extinguished, blocked minds from directing their inner regard toward illumination, and drove them to reject the truth by which their humanity stands.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS: It establishes the conflict between Divine illumination and the obstructing falsity that forbids turning toward it.

paragraph_translations.translation: People are in ignorance about spiritual realities: they do not grasp the magnitude of that illuminating Divine presence, they reject the free gift continually extended to them, and they fail to perceive its holiness. They also do not understand the goods it accomplishes for them even while they still live in external states; for whenever wisdom flows down into the outer person it performs innumerable mercies for the human race, and yet they deny benefits whose origin they will not recognize.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS: It laments the human failure to acknowledge illumination and its benefits even while receiving them.

paragraph_translations.translation: Whenever this illuminating influx enters external life, it carries out a complete course of operations in human states, and these effects are able to be noticed.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES: It introduces the ordered series of operations that follow from received illumination.
paragraph_translations.notes: The number-based structure is retained as a full course; the exact force of 'seven' as full process is assumed.

paragraph_translations.translation: The first operation is enlightenment itself: it opens the understanding in all people so that they can discern in conduct what lies before them and how they are to proceed, and it removes the obscurity of falsity that had made them unable to see.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES: It begins enumerating the effects of illumination in the outer person.

paragraph_translations.translation: The second operation is tranquility and peace: when wisdom is received into the life of the outer person it brings calming order throughout, and it removes the anxieties and tremors that filled the inner life during obscurity; it dispels falsity by truth and by that quieting influx fear is extinguished.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES: It adds the pacifying effect of truth on fearful states.

paragraph_translations.translation: The third operation is awakening into vigilance: when illumination comes, those who were in spiritual sleep rise into attention, and the outermost faculties that had been strained in anxious guarding relax from that strained watchfulness, because truth present in ultimates restores orderly use.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES: It shifts from peace to alertness and orderly cessation of anxious guarding.

paragraph_translations.translation: The fourth operation is fructification in the whole lower life: it gives nourishment and vigor, discernment and delight, to perceptions and to the works that proceed from them, and it vitalizes general and particular truths and tender beginnings of good throughout the whole extent of external life.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES: It widens the effect of illumination to growth and productivity in externals.

paragraph_translations.translation: The fifth operation is restraint of predatory evils: when enlightenment spreads through the outer person, malicious cravings and violent falsities full of harm withdraw into their hidden interiors.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES: It shows illumination forcing active evils out of open operation.

paragraph_translations.translation: The sixth operation is healing and the breaking of enchantment: when truth shines in the mind, the pain of spiritual injury is eased, and the deceptive practices by which the wicked manipulate and harm are dissolved.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES: It adds restoration and the undoing of deceit as effects of truth.
paragraph_translations.notes: ‘Evil arts’ is rendered as deceptive practices; the specific kind of magic/charms is unclear.

paragraph_translations.translation: The seventh operation is testimony and manifestation: in external life it makes evident a sign that the heavenly domain of wisdom and its Divine splendor are real and present, and through that witness illumination is extended through the whole created mind.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES: It completes the series by making the influx a visible witness throughout the mind.
paragraph_translations.notes: ‘Aeons of light’ is treated as the heavenly domain of wisdom; exact cosmology is compressed.

paragraph_translations.translation: Great folly has seized those who are in falsified worship: they neither perceive the holy secret of this illuminating presence nor even attend to the benefits it continually performs for them. They let these gifts pass without recognition.
paragraph_translations.connection: SHIFTS: It moves from describing effects to condemning the failure to perceive them.

paragraph_translations.translation: As illumination has been set forth with its complete operations in external life, so the opposite state must be understood: obscurity, within which evils find their opportunity. Whenever that obscurity descends upon the outer person, it brings a complete course of infestations.
paragraph_translations.connection: SHIFTS: It turns from the operations of illumination to the parallel operations of obscurity.

paragraph_translations.translation: The first infestation is the spread of falsity: when illumination is withdrawn from the external mind and truth no longer acts there, obscurity immediately extends through the whole natural degree. People’s understanding is filled with denial and confusion, and they neither discern nor rightly perceive because falsity dominates the whole outer life.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES: It begins the series of evils produced by obscurity.

paragraph_translations.translation: The second infestation is fear: when obscurity looms and strengthens, dread and trembling seize human minds, and external life is filled with the oppressive presence of that state.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES: It adds fear as a direct effect of obscurity.

paragraph_translations.translation: The third infestation is inward rebellion: when truth is absent, affections and thoughts rise into disorder, and the heart turns toward doing evils and rushing into spiritual ruin.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES: It deepens the portrayal from fear to the will’s revolt toward evil.

paragraph_translations.translation: The fourth infestation is spiritual stupor: a heavy torpor settles on people; they fall into negligence and listlessness, and they become deathlike in respect to what is living and saving.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES: It portrays obscurity producing a deadened state of mind.

paragraph_translations.translation: The fifth infestation is the concealment and distortion of what is human: when falsity covers the outer life, the distinct form of each person’s quality is hidden; mutual recognition of what is good and true between people is obscured, and what should appear as spiritual beauty is not manifested.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES: It shows obscurity hiding the true qualities by which people are known.

paragraph_translations.translation: The sixth infestation is the empowerment of evildoing: when obscurity takes rule, those who love evil come forth into action—those who profane good, those who steal truth for self, and those who secretly poison the understanding. Bestial affections and crawling falsities rise from hidden loves and begin to prowl through external life. Infernal influences also gain freer operation. Conflicts, assaults, injuries, and outpourings of harm torment people because in that state every evil is strengthened.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES: It expands into a full outbreak of evils and infernal influence under obscurity.
paragraph_translations.notes: The catalogue of criminals is generalized into spiritual evils; some specificity may be lost.

paragraph_translations.translation: The seventh infestation is the manifestation of infernal origin: the state of obscurity displays in external life a sign of the active falsity from which it proceeds, because this obscurity is an effect of primal denial made present in the outer person. This effect intertwines and binds disordered things in both higher and lower regions of the mind.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES: It completes the series by tracing obscurity back to its originating falsity.
paragraph_translations.notes: The language of ‘father’ and ‘first darkness’ is rendered as originating falsity and primal denial.

paragraph_translations.translation: These complete infestations of obscurity recur in external life, yet those in falsified worship do not understand what this state is nor the source from which it draws its power—that all these evils are strengthened within it.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES: It concludes the night-series with a charge of ignorance about obscurity’s power.

paragraph_translations.translation: Within illumination as it acts upon the outer person there is a sufficient set of universal qualities that become present as it meets each state of external life.
paragraph_translations.connection: SHIFTS: It moves from the seven operations to a set of universal qualities within illumination.
paragraph_translations.notes: ‘Five archetypes’ is taken as ‘sufficient universal qualities’ per number symbolism.

paragraph_translations.translation: The first universal quality is enlightenment itself, by which the natural mind and all affections and thoughts within it are made able to see.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES: It begins listing the universal qualities present in illumination.

paragraph_translations.translation: The second universal quality is spiritual beauty: when illumination is present it pours ordered loveliness into affections and thoughts and gives a pleasing form to the life.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES: It adds beauty as an effect of ordered truth.

paragraph_translations.translation: The third universal quality is peace: when wisdom’s truth is received, people take on gentler affection through it and come into mutual concord.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES: It adds peace as a universal quality of illumination.

paragraph_translations.translation: The fourth universal quality is the life of the living inner mind: it brings liberation from compulsions and entanglements in both higher and lower bondage, so that the soul can act from freedom according to order.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES: It turns from social peace to inward liberation into life.
paragraph_translations.notes: ‘Bonds and fetters of heaven and earth’ is treated as higher/lower bondage; exact referent is uncertain but coherent.

paragraph_translations.translation: The fifth universal quality is strengthening in ultimates together with delight in the whole complex of doctrine that bears witness to Divine love and wisdom.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES: It completes the fivefold qualities with power in externals and relish for doctrine.
paragraph_translations.notes: ‘Elements’ and ‘Cross of the Light’ resist precise mapping; rendered as ultimates and the integrated structure of saving truth.

paragraph_translations.translation: From this it can be seen that the illumination of wisdom in external life surpasses every lesser understanding that appears there; that the beauty it bestows exceeds merely natural attractiveness; that its peace is higher than any external securities people set up; that its liberation of the living inner mind surpasses every other release; and that the strength it supplies to operative powers in ultimates is mightier than all merely natural strength.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS: It elevates the listed qualities as pre-eminent above all external counterparts.
paragraph_translations.notes: ‘Powers and guards’ is treated as external securities/defenses.

paragraph_translations.translation: Beyond these, three further universal marks become apparent through this illumination, disclosing something of the secret of the First Divine.
paragraph_translations.connection: SHIFTS: It introduces a deeper set of signs pointing upward to the Divine Source.

paragraph_translations.translation: The first mark is unceasing plenitude in the receptive form through which illumination acts: it is continually filled and does not diminish by alternations as derivative illumination does. This constant fullness manifests the inexhaustible Divine Source, from whom all capacities and all objects of worship in the mind proceed, and in whom no lack can exist.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES: It gives the first higher mark—Divine inexhaustibility shown by steady fullness.
paragraph_translations.notes: Ship/disk imagery is translated as ‘receptive form’ holding influx.

paragraph_translations.translation: The second mark is incomparable supremacy: this illumination exceeds all lesser truths and derivative lights throughout the mental universe, revealing that the Divine Light is greater than even the light of the heavenly degrees.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES: It adds the superiority of Divine wisdom above all subordinate lights.

paragraph_translations.translation: The third mark is transcendence of degree: this illumination stands above every elevated natural state and surpasses every exalted condition attainable in external life. It makes known that the First Divine is above the whole ordered heaven of wisdom and above every height of spiritual life, and that Divine fullness remains in its own likeness from eternity to eternity.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES: It completes the higher marks with the Divine’s supreme elevation and perpetual fullness.
paragraph_translations.notes: The repeated ‘filled up in his image’ is rendered as perpetual fullness in likeness; phrasing in the source is syntactically broken.

paragraph_translations.translation: Thus two mysteries are set before the created mind again and again: the recurring appearance of enlightenment and of obscurity in orderly alternation within external life. By this, the difference between truth from good and falsity from evil is made visible daily, yet those who are in error do not recognize it.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS: It gathers the teaching into a dual mystery displayed repeatedly in created order.
paragraph_translations.notes: ‘Day and night’ are rendered as states of enlightenment/obscurity.

paragraph_translations.translation: The primary mystery of Divine illumination is made present in the natural degree as a secondary inflowing light that comes continually into outer life. In all its operations it shows itself to be good, proceeding from good itself: it comes from the good Divine Source and becomes apparent within external existence.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES: It identifies received illumination as an outward manifestation of the Divine Good.
paragraph_translations.notes: The language of ‘second light-giver’ is treated as derivative influx into externals.

paragraph_translations.translation: In contrast, the state of obscurity, full of fear, exists from the mystery of active falsity. It discloses its essence in external life by all its evils, manifesting its origin repeatedly; yet those in error do not know it and cannot distinguish enlightenment from obscurity.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES: It opposes obscurity’s origin and effects to illumination’s goodness.

paragraph_translations.translation: Those who receive and live from illumination are born from it and belong to it; but if they take on the quality of obscurity, they are born from that state and belong to it.
paragraph_translations.connection: SHIFTS: It applies the two mysteries directly to identity and spiritual lineage.
paragraph_translations.notes: The bracketed clause is integrated as conditional adoption of obscurity.

paragraph_translations.translation: Blessed are those whose inner life has come to know these two mysteries and to understand their order: that enlightenment exists from the Divine Light and obscurity from active falsity; that they do not arise from one another. Blessed is the one who can discern these two origins—good with its truth and evil with its falsity—as not derived from each other, for by this discernment the mind is led into eternal life.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS: It concludes with beatitude grounded in discernment between the two non-deriving origins.

spiritual_reading.overall_coherence: Highly coherent as a single doctrinal-ethical contrast between two recurring spiritual states: enlightenment from Divine good and obscurity from falsity. The chapter is structurally strong in its two sevenfold sequences and later fivefold and threefold summaries; the only minor stumble is where specialized cosmological terms (aeons, Cross of the Light, ship/disk) require compression into functional spiritual language.

findings.diagnosis: Clean, continuous correspondential teaching structured as two parallel sevenfold sequences (sun/day vs night/darkness). No narrative break; the spiritual reading tracks smoothly because the spiritual sense arises from what sun/night DO (open eyes, calm fear, awaken, fructify; then darken, terrify, incite revolt, etc.).
findings.evidence: Text teaches by function and effect: e.g., sun: “It opens the eyes of all mankind… takes away the blindness of the night” (¶5); “bring calm and peace… take away… fear and trembling” (¶6); “all sleeping mankind shall arise” (¶7). Night: “fill the entire world… eyes… fill with blackness” (¶14); “fear and… trembling” (¶15); “all creatures take up revolt” (¶16). Stage-3a reading shows no forcing here and explicitly calls the chapter “Highly coherent… two sevenfold sequences” (Overall Coherence).

findings.diagnosis: Minor ideological polemic embedded within otherwise functional teaching: the ‘Satan placed an exclusionary judgement in his law that no one worship it’ is not administrative taxonomy, but it is a polemical mythic frame that is slightly less correspondential than the rest. It does not, however, break the narrative or introduce jurisdictions/ranks; it functions as an etiological preface for why people deny the sun/light.
findings.evidence: The passage introduces a legal-prohibitive motif: “he placed an exclusionary judgement in his law… Whoever will worship it can die” (¶2). The remainder immediately returns to functional effects (¶3-11). The spiritual reading did not stumble here; it treated it as ‘adversarial love of self… forbidding decree’ and moved on without a seam, indicating no textual disruption—only a slight voice tilt toward mythic polemic rather than pure correspondence.

findings.diagnosis: Potential seam/overlay in didactic mode: a new enumerated schema (‘five archetypes’) is introduced after the completed seven/seven contrast. This is not administrative (no jurisdictions, named rulers, stations), but it is systematizing and less tightly grounded in immediate observation, especially in items 4–5 (“release… living soul… bonds and fetters of heaven and earth”; “Cross of the Light”). The spiritual reading’s only recorded ‘stumble’ occurs here as terminological compression, consistent with a secondary doctrinal gloss expanding the earlier functional list into Manichaean technical categories.
findings.evidence: Hard transition: after concluding the night’s seven and rebuking the sects (¶21), the text abruptly: “There are five archetypes occur in the sun” (¶22) with no narrative need. Items 1–3 remain close to prior functions (“light… beauty… peace,” ¶23-25). Items 4–5 introduce specialist cosmological/soteriological mechanisms: “life of the living soul… release from… bonds and fetters of heaven and earth” (¶26) and “scent and a taste to the entire Cross of the Light” (¶27). Stage-3a explicitly notes resistance here: “ ‘Five archetypes’ is taken as ‘sufficient universal qualities’… ‘Elements’ and ‘Cross of the Light’ resist precise mapping” (¶22, ¶27 Notes). That kind of forced paraphrase is a classic symptom of a seam where later technical doctrine overlays an earlier functional exposition.
findings.scope: Annotate ¶22-28 as a secondary fivefold systematizing overlay that introduces Manichaean technical terms (‘living soul’ release; ‘elements’; ‘Cross of the Light’) after the completed seven/seven correspondential sequence.

findings.diagnosis: Secondary cosmological allegoresis (“ship/disk,” comparative astronomy, height) that recasts the sun into a metaphysical proof-text for the Father of Greatness. This remains correspondential in method (argues from what the sun does/is like), but the highly technical cosmology and the syntactically damaged clause in ¶32 produce the spiritual-reading stumble (compression, repair). Likely not an intrusive administrative list; more plausibly a doctrinal expansion attached after the fivefold ‘archetypes’.
findings.evidence: The section announces a new layer: “another three archetypes… mystery of the first greatness” (¶29). It then reads like cosmological apologetic: “filling up of the disk of its ship… displays the mystery of the Father” (¶30); “light surpasses… corresponding to… light of the Father” (¶31); “sun is very high… corresponding to… Father of Greatness” (¶32). Stage-3a flags textual difficulty: “Ship/disk imagery… ‘receptive form’… source is syntactically broken” (¶30 Notes; ¶32 Notes: “phrasing… syntactically broken”). That indicates either damage or later scholastic elaboration; but removing it would not restore a broken story because ¶33 naturally summarizes and ¶34-35 continue the same dualism teaching.

findings.diagnosis: Clean concluding recapitulation and ethical application of the day/night dualism. The voice is correspondential-exhortative, not administrative; it ties back to the observable alternation and draws identity/beatitude. No stumble reported beyond a missing ¶36 and a bracketed phrase in ¶37, which look like transmission damage rather than insertion.
findings.evidence: Recap: “two mysteries… night and… day… displayed daily” (¶33); identification: “sun… second light-giver… came from the good Father” (¶34) and “night… after the mystery of the darkness” (¶35); application: “children of the day… if… character of the darkness…” (¶37) and beatitude on distinguishing non-derivation (¶38). Stage-3a finds coherence through the end. The bracketed lacuna in ¶37 and missing paragraph number ¶36 suggest manuscript damage/omission, not an administrative overlay.

textual_criticism.summary: 5 findings total. Core chapter (¶2-21; ¶33-35; ¶37-38) is a coherent correspondential substrate with no excisions warranted. One likely secondary didactic overlay is ¶22-28 (five ‘archetypes’)—recommend annotate as later technical systematization, not excise. ¶29-32 shows technical cosmological allegoresis and some syntactic damage but still fits the chapter’s trajectory; recommend no action.

harmonized_paragraphs.text: He says, it is the gate of life and the vessel of peace, to this great aeon of light [which comes daily to the world]. ⟨p.159⟩ However, since Satan knows that it is the gate of the souls' departure, he placed an exclusionary judgement in his law that no one worship it, saying: Whoever will worship it can die. He has otherwise called it: The light that will be nullified. He has hindered the souls from themselves turning their faces towards the light. He has caused them to deny the light of their being.

Now, people are blind about everything! They have not understood the greatness of this great light-giver. They have denied the grace of this great light that shines upon them. They have not perceived its greatness and its divinity. Nor, also, have they understood the good things that it does for them, even today, as they are entrenched in their body; when it comes to this world and shines. Behold: How many are the charities that it does for mankind! Yet they, for their part, deny its graces, which they know not.
Every day, would this great light-giver shine its light, it shall do seven good things for them. Shall they not see them?

The first good thing that it does for them is its light, which it shines upon them. It opens the eyes of all mankind. They see underfoot as they walk by it. It takes away the blindness of the night, which made them blind with its darkness.

The second: When (the sun) is come to the world, with its coming it shall bring calm and peace to the entire world. With its coming it shall also take away from them all the fear and trembling, which their heart is filled with the whole night; for it shall take away the darkness present by its light, and sweep it out. Also, this is how it extinguishes fear by its calm.

The third is its vigil; because when (the sun) comes to the world all sleeping mankind shall arise and awake. And the watchmen too shall cease from watching. The guards who sit at the gates of camps, they break vigil at the watchposts, because of its light that has shone upon them in the world.
⟨p.160⟩ The fourth: It shall nourish, and give strength, taste and scent, to the trees and fruits and vegetables, and all the herbs, and the flowers and grasses, which are upon the entire earth.
The fifth: When (the sun) shines in all the world, the evil reptile and the sharp-toothed beasts that are filled of wickedness, they shall flee to hiding in their dens.
The sixth: When it shines its light, the wound of any person is eased from pain. Its light shall melt away the evil arts of every doer of wickedness.

The seventh: (The sun) shall display and manifest to the world the sign of the splendour of the aeons of light, from which it has come out; it here in this world being their sign. It brings light to the whole of creation.

Behold: How great is the foolishness that has befallen the sects of error! Not only that they have not perceived the mystery of the divinity of this great light-giver; but also, even all the benefits that it does for them. They forget them. They do not perceive them.

Now, just as I have shown you the sun, which does seven good things in the world, hear also what I teach you about the night, for it has all wickednesses therein. Every occasion, would the night fall, it shall do seven evils in the world.

The first wickedness that the night shall do in the world is the darkness, with which it shall fill the entire world; because when the sun sinks from the world and draws to it its rays, at that instant the shadow of the night shall spread out over the whole world. The eyes of the people fill with blackness. They neither see nor wonder with their eyes, because of the darkness of the night which shall fill the whole world.
The second evil thing that the night shall do is its fear; because when its shadow looms forth, its fear and its trembling shall possess all of mankind. The entire world shall fill of the night.
The third: When the night falls, all creatures take up revolt. They rebel in their heart, to do wickedness and perdition.
The fourth: The heaviness of sleep shall lay upon them, and they fall asleep; they slumber and doze, and they are like these corpses in the night.

The fifth is its ugliness; again, when the night would fall, the form of the people shall be hidden in the darkness and the ugliness of the night. The beauty and the form of men and women shall not be displayed before one another, because of its darkness and its ugliness, which it shall spread out over all their forms.

The sixth occasion is when the night would fall on the world. At that instant evil people shall come out to do wickedness; the adulterers, and the robbers and poisoners. The evil beasts shall come out, and all the reptiles that are filled with wickedness, from their dens. And they stalk in the night. Also, the demons and fiends find power to do wickedness in the night. Again, the blows and buffets and wounds and discharges shall torment people in the night; because in it the whole of evil shall find strength.

The seventh: The night shall display the sign of the darkness, its father. It has arisen out of its essence; because this night that came out of this first darkness has been displayed in the world. Note this night, the shadow of this first darkness, the one that is entwined and bound in all things above and below.

Behold, I have taught you about these seven wickednesses of the black night; the ones that it shall do daily in the world, in the night. The sects have not seen this black night: what it is; nor from whence is its essence. That all these evils find strength in it!
There are five archetypes occur in the sun, it making them [five archetypes] as it finds the world.
⟨p.162⟩ The first is its light; for it illumines by its light the world, and all the creatures who exist in it.
The second is its beauty; because when it shines, it shall flood beauty and loveliness upon all creatures and everything.
The third is its peace; for, again, when the sun would shine on the world, all people shall receive affection through it, and give peace to one another.
The fourth is the life of the living soul, which it shall release from all the bonds and fetters of heaven and earth.
The fifth: It gives a strength to the elements; and also it gives a scent and a taste to the entire Cross of the Light.

So, you yourselves see that its light illumines more than all lights that occur in the world. Also, its beauty is more beautiful than all the beauties of mankind. Again, its peace is more surpassing than all the powers and guards who exist in the world. Its releasing action, by which it releases the living soul, is a full day ahead of all releasing actions! The strength that it gives to its limbs is a great strength, being mightier than all strengths!
Once again, there are another three archetypes made apparent by the sun, in respect of the mystery of the first greatness.

The first is the filling up of the disk of its ship; because its ship has filled up every season, and shall not wane at all, the way that the ship of the moon wanes. This continuous filling, by which it is filled, displays the mystery of the Father, the great greatness; from whom all the powers and the gods have come forth. He shall never wane, nor shall lack ever exist in him!

The second: (The sun's) light surpasses the light of all the stars, and all the lights that occur in the universe; corresponding to the mystery of the light of the Father; for his light surpasses and is greater than the light of his aeons.

⟨p.163⟩ The third: This sun is very high above all else. It surpasses the height of all the mountains and hills that exist upon the entire earth, corresponding to the mystery of the Father of Greatness; for he is high above all the household of his light-earth. Also, because the Father himself is high above all the heights and the mountains of his light-earth. He is 'filled up' in his image [every] the time and every hour from eternity to eternity!

[Behold]ld the two mysteries I have taught you, O my beloved ones! The mystery of the night and that of the day, which daily come forth in the world. Now, the mystery of the light and the mystery of the darkness are displayed daily in the created order. The sects have not seen them in their error!

The mystery of the first great light is the sun, which is this second light-giver, the one that comes daily to the world. It displays all the marks of its graces, displaying and signifying on its own behalf that it is good, out of the essence of the good. It came from the good Father and appeared in this world.

In contrast, this night that is made of fear exists after the mystery of the darkness. Behold too the mystery of its essence! It displays it in the world in all these wickednesses. It displays this mystery daily in the world, but the sects know it not in their error. They do not distinguish the mystery of the light from that of the darkness.
You are the children of the day and the children of the light. However, you <[if you shall take up] the character of the darkness> are the children of the night and the children of the darkness.

⟨p.164⟩ Yet, blessed are you, my beloved ones! Blessed are your souls, for you have known the mystery of the day and that of the night. You have understood, that the day exists after the mystery of the light, but the night after the mystery of the darkness. They have not arisen from one another. Blessed is he who can know this mystery and distinguish these two essences, that of the light and that of the darkness, the ones that have not arisen from one another; so that he can inherit life eternal!
